newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MISC shares up on stake sale rumours.
newsitem.headline: MISC shares up on stake sale rumours.

text.p: Malaysian International Shipping Corporation Bhd (MISC) shares rose sharply on Wednesday on rumours that rival Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd may be eyeing a stake in the company, dealers said.
"MISC shares are moving on rumours of a takeover by (transport group) Konsortium," said an institutional dealer at a local bank-backed brokerage.
MISC's foreign tranche of shares were the second most actively-traded of the morning session, gaining 20 cents to 6.30 ringgit with 4.3 million shares traded around midday.
The local tranche shares gained five cents to 6.35 with just 25,000 shares traded.
MISC's foreign shares were trading more actively than the local shares because they were still at a discount to the local tranche, said dealers.
An official at MISC declined to comment, while Konsortium officials could not be immediately reached.
"The foreign shares are cheaper relative to the local shares, but they are catching up. It is better than buying the local shares," said the dealer.
"The rumour is that the Employees Provident Fund (the state pension fund) is looking to sell its 30-percent-stake in MISC," said a senior analyst at another local brokerage house.
Analysts suggested the deal would benefit Konsortium, as it would strengthen its shipping arm Diperdana Corporation Bhd . Konsortium is primarily a land-based haulage company.
